title: Quantum Hopf rigidity in symmetric monoidal categories
summary: We prove that a coaction of a Hopf algebra on another preserving the latter's associative-algebra structure and comultiplication automatically also preserves the counit, antipode, and tensor-interchange map and in fact factors through the coaction dual to an action of an affine group scheme by Hopf-algebra automorphisms. This generalizes and unifies a number of results to the effect that quantum groups have only classical symmetries, due to Kasprzak et al., Budziński-Kasprzak and Brannan et al.
